Lemon Pasta Chicken
By: Stephanie Kjenaas
Published: Tuesday, February 23, 2010 - 11:34am

Ingredients




What You Will Need:

1 small package of your favorite kind of pasta
olive oil enough to coat the cooked pasta with

2 tablespoons or 3  of lemon juice
salt

pepper

large bowl

drainer for the spaghetti

inch saucepan to cook the noodles
serving plate

a fork

my lemon chicken

Preparation

1 How Do You Make It: 2 Cook the pasta accroding the the pasta package directions. 3 When the pasta is done cooking drain the pasta. 4 After you drain the pasta put it in a large bowl. 5 Coat and mix the pasta with olive oil but not to much olive oil just enough to coat the pasta. 6 Pour in 3 tablespoons of lemon juice and mix well. 7 After you mix in the lemon juice season the pasta with salt and pepper. 8 Serve the pasta on a serving plate you can have this with the lemon chicken that I made.

About


Hey, my name is Stephanie. You can call me Chef Steph. I will be posting a new recipe every day. Leave comments and I will answer any questions you have. Thanks for visting!
